title: Preservation of unassigned locals
statement: Fix a program environment, resource limits, and execution depth. If a statement $s$ can execute from state $\sigma$ with cost at most $T$ to a state satisfying $Q$, then it can execute with the same cost bound to a state satisfying $Q$ in which every local variable not assigned by $s$ has the same value as in $\sigma$.
hypotheses_covered: There is an execution of $s$ from $\sigma$ with cost at most $T$ ending in a state satisfying $Q$
